summary: Abco Kovex is a subsidiary of Bunzl plc, headquartered in Swords, Dublin, Ireland, with operations in Ireland, the United Kingdom, and Germany. The company manufactures and distributes stretch film, strapping, protective packaging, edge boards, and packaging machinery to industrial and commercial customers. It operates both online and offline, representing brands such as Bunzl and Abco Kovex.

Acme Paper & Supply is a privately held wholesale packaging distributor headquartered in Savage, Maryland, United States, with operational presence across the United States. Founded in 1946, the company supplies foodservice, retail, and industrial packaging, as well as janitorial equipment, cleaning supplies, and restaurant equipment and smallwares. It offers creative packaging solutions and regional delivery for commercial customers, operating through both online and offline channels.

Adelaide Packaging Supplies is a family-owned distributor and retailer based in Gillman, Adelaide, South Australia, operating since 1991. They supply a comprehensive range of packaging and mailing materials, workplace supplies, cleaning and hygiene products, hospitality supplies, office supplies, technology accessories, furniture, and art and craft supplies. They serve customers across Australia through both an online store and offline channels, with a focus on ethical and local choices including Australian-made and Indigenous products. Key brands represented include Jiffy and Deb.

Ahlsell is a leading multi-vertical specialist distributor of installation products, tools, and supplies in the Nordics, operating both online and offline. Headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, it serves professional trades and industry across Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, Estonia, and Poland. The company supplies installation products, tools, personal protective equipment, industrial supplies, and technical products. Founded in 1877, it is privately owned and backed by CVC Capital Partners.

All American Containers, founded in 1991 and headquartered in Miami, Florida, is a rigid packaging distributor of glass, plastic, and metal containers, along with closures and dispensers, serving food, beverage, personal care, and industrial packers. It operates across the United States, Puerto Rico, Mexico, Panama, and Taiwan, and is a subsidiary of TricorBraun. The company sells through both online and offline channels and represents brands including TricorBraun.

All Packaging Company, founded in 1946 and headquartered in Aurora, Colorado, is a privately held manufacturer and distributor of packaging solutions. They specialize in rigid set-up boxes, corrugated packaging, custom specialty boxes, stock boxes, and packaging supplies, offering custom design services for various box types. Operating offline across the United States, they serve as a one-stop shop for packaging needs, from small runs to large quantities.

Allied Packaging is a packaging distributor based in Botany, New South Wales, Australia, operating since 2000. It supplies flexible packaging, industrial packaging supplies, and protective packaging to commercial and industrial customers, with a focus on stock packaging for trade buyers. The company operates both online and offline, serving the Australian market.

Allpack is a UK-based packaging supplier headquartered in Cannock, operating primarily online. They offer a comprehensive range of packaging products including cardboard boxes, packing tape, bubble wrap, postal packaging, protective materials, polythene, pallet wrap, strapping, and chilled packaging. Their product portfolio includes brands such as Airsac, BubbleGuard, BubbleMask, Instapack, and Ranpak. They serve various sectors including aerospace, automotive, and medical.

American Packaging Distributors is a privately held, family-owned distributor of packaging and shipping supplies headquartered in West Chester, Pennsylvania, serving clients across the United States. Founded in 1988, the company supplies strapping, packing film, bags, janitorial products, corrugated boxes, tapes, protective packaging, and shipping supplies. It operates both online and offline, offering advanced packaging designs, equipment, and maintenance services through its AP Advantage Program. The company partners with trusted vendors to provide high-quality products and equipment.

Antalis is a B2B distributor of papers, packaging supplies, and visual communication materials, operating in 34 countries across Europe, Canada, and Latin America. Headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt, France, it serves over 100,000 customers with a team of 4,300 employees and 120 distribution centres. The company offers a range of packaging products including boxes, tapes, cushioning, postal packaging, and packaging papers, and represents brands such as Jiffy, Sealed Air, and Master'in. Antalis operates both online and offline channels.

Aropack is a private, family-run flexible packaging company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Hythe, Kent, United Kingdom, operating primarily in the UK. They supply custom printed plastic bags, pouches, and films, including stand-up pouches, flat bottom bags, quad seal bags, side gusset bags, spout pouches, retort pouches, flow wrap films, lidding films, re-closable films, and ovenable films. Their offerings include recyclable and compostable packaging options, with services such as digital printing, packaging design, mock-ups, and stock holding. They operate both online and offline, serving brands worldwide.

Askul is a Japanese B2B e-commerce distributor of office and business supplies, including shipping and packaging materials, retail bags, facility products, and related consumables. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, it operates online with nationwide next-day logistics across multiple distribution centers in Japan and a presence in China. The company is publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and is a major shareholder of LY Corporation.

Associated Bag is a private wholesale manufacturer-distributor of packaging supplies, headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with additional locations in Pennsylvania, Texas, and Nevada. Founded in 1938, the company supplies a wide range of products including plastic bags, corrugated boxes, bubble cushioning, stretch wrap, tape, and static control materials, with stock and custom printing options. It operates online and serves commercial customers across the United States, representing brands such as Sealed Air, 3M, Scotch, Instapak, and Tesa.

Associated Packaging is a full-service packaging distributor headquartered in Gallatin, Tennessee, operating across the United States. Founded in 1977, the company supplies end-of-line packaging materials and equipment, including shrink and stretch wrap, bagging systems, and packaging machinery, along with technical services, automation and integration, and continuous improvement programs. It serves customers through both online and offline channels, representing multi-brand packaging materials and equipment principals.

Atlantic Packaging Corp is a packaging distributor and solutions provider headquartered in Wilmington, North Carolina, with operations across the United States. Founded in 1946, the company supplies packaging equipment and materials, specializing in stretch wrapping, shrink packaging, case forming and sealing, strapping, marking/coding/labeling, and protective packaging. They operate both online and offline, offering technical services and an in-house Packaging Solution Center for research and testing. The company represents multiple packaging equipment and materials brands.

Atlantic Packaging Products is a privately held, integrated packaging manufacturer-distributor headquartered in Scarborough, Ontario, Canada, with operations across Canada and the United States. Founded in 1945, the company supplies corrugated packaging, paper bags, retail packaging and displays, packaging supplies, and recycling services, serving retail and industrial customers through converting and distribution operations. It operates both online and offline channels, with multiple facilities in Ontario and the U.S. states of Illinois, Ohio, and Pennsylvania.

Auspackaging is an online wholesale distributor based in Sydney, Australia, operating since 2011. They supply a comprehensive range of packaging products including cardboard boxes, protective packaging, plastic products, tapes, strapping, and packaging machinery, with a focus on sustainable and eco-friendly options. Their products cater to industries such as retail, online, healthcare, and electronics, and they serve customers across Australia.

Bags and Bows is a private wholesale packaging distributor headquartered in Trevose, Pennsylvania, United States, operating primarily online. Founded in 1904, the company supplies wholesale packaging products including bags and bows, and offers custom printing services to meet customer packaging needs. It serves customers across the United States.

Bags Plus is a privately owned Australian distributor specializing in custom printed bags, offering a wide range of paper, plastic, non-woven, cotton, and eco-friendly options. Founded in 1985 and headquartered in Malvern, Victoria, Australia, the company supplies over 100 bag models to businesses across Australia, providing branding and printing services with quick turnaround and delivery. Operating offline, Bags Plus focuses on promotional and custom printed bags, including food paper bags, postal satchels, and VCI products.

Bags Unlimited is an online collection protection supply company headquartered in Rochester, New York, serving the United States since 1976. They supply archival-quality bags, sleeves, jackets, storage boxes, mailers, frames, and cleaning products for vinyl records, CDs, audio tapes, cassettes, comic books, posters, lobby cards, books, and magazines. They serve collectors, retailers, and distributors, offering custom printing options for record store bags and jackets. Key brands represented include SafeSpace, Tyvek, MicroChamber, and Groovy Cleaner.

Ball & Doggett is a privately owned Australian distributor of printable materials and packaging-related supplies, headquartered in Dandenong South, Victoria. Operating across Australia, the company supplies paper, packaging, print consumables, and industrial media, with a specialty focus on packaging and printing materials. It represents brands such as CMPC and Sappi, and operates through both online and offline channels.

BASCO is a privately held wholesale distributor of industrial packaging containers and shipping supplies, headquartered in University Park, Illinois, USA. Founded in 1946, the company operates across the United States, supplying industrial containers, drums, pails, and IBC totes. Its channel mode is not specified in the provided facts.

BB-Verpackungen is an online retailer and distributor of packaging materials based in Delmenhorst, Germany, operating since 2006. The company supplies a broad range of products including cartons, shipping and packaging materials, moving kits, mailing bags, adhesive tapes, strapping, bubble wrap, films, and packing machines and workstations. It serves customers in Germany through its online platform, offering packaging advice and optimization services. The company also operates additional online shops for packaging and moving supplies.

BigDug is a privately owned UK-based online B2B supplier of warehouse equipment, shelving, and packaging and storage supplies. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Gloucester, United Kingdom, the company operates primarily online across the UK. Its product range includes shelving, racking, handling equipment, lifting gear, workbenches, flooring, tools, workwear, PPE, and packaging such as cardboard boxes and pallets.

Blackwoods is an industrial and safety distributor headquartered in Macquarie Park, New South Wales, Australia, and a subsidiary of Wesfarmers. Founded in 1878, it operates across Australia and New Zealand, supplying MRO, safety products, tools, packaging and consumables, and engineering supplies to enterprise and trade customers. The company serves customers through both online and offline channels.

Box and Packaging Supply is a business distributor and wholesaler of packaging supplies, operating in the United States since 1988. They supply flexible packaging materials, films, bags, stretch and shrink wrap, and other packaging materials. The company serves customers through both online and offline channels.

Box Brothers is a privately held packaging retailer and distributor headquartered in Woodland Hills, California, operating across the United States. Founded in 1985, the company supplies moving boxes, shipping boxes, and packaging supplies, with a specialty focus on professional packing, custom crating, and carrier shipping services for consumers and small businesses. It operates both online and offline channels.

BOX Partners is a privately held wholesale distributor of corrugated boxes and shipping supplies, founded in 1989 and headquartered in Elgin, Illinois, with operations across the United States. The company supplies a range of packaging materials, including corrugated boxes, shipping supplies, and moving boxes, catering to business customers with large in-stock assortments and volume fulfillment. It operates primarily online, serving its customers through its website.

Boxmart is a UK-based wholesale packaging supplier headquartered in Shenstone, Staffordshire, operating both online and offline. Founded in 2004, they supply a wide range of packaging including gift boxes, postal boxes, hamper packaging, clear lid boxes, and transit packaging, with services such as custom printing and bespoke packaging. They serve customers across the United Kingdom and offer same-day despatch for orders placed by 3pm.

Boxworks is a private Australian wholesaler of gift packaging and boxes, headquartered in Bayswater North, Victoria. Founded in 2019, the company operates across Australia, specializing in wholesale packaging and gift wrap solutions. It serves the B2B market as a distributor of packaging products.

Braden Packaging & Supply is a nationwide distributor of packaging, shipping, and janitorial supplies, operating online. Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Clinton, New York, the company supplies packaging tapes, industrial tapes, shipping boxes, mailers, poly bags, pallet wrap, and janitorial supplies. It serves customers across the United States with warehouses in Utica and Chicago, offering services like custom tape cutting and no minimum orders. Key brands represented include SpecTape, Shurtape, Intertape, Central Tape, Tesa Tape, 3M, Malpack, Sigma, Sealed Air, and Cryovac.

BradyPLUS is a private distributor of janitorial and sanitation, foodservice packaging, and industrial packaging supplies, headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with operations across the United States. Founded in 2023, it serves commercial facility and foodservice operations through both online and offline channels, offering regional fulfillment and services such as commercial kitchen design and packaging innovation.

Brown Packaging is a packaging supplier based in Anaheim, California, operating across the United States. Founded in 1987, the company provides both online and offline services, offering custom and stock packaging products such as corrugated boxes, folding cartons, pouches, foam packaging, rigid boxes, mailers, and POP displays. They also support customers with services like packaging cost audits, structural and graphic design, sampling, prototyping, and fulfillment/contract packaging.

Brown Paper Packaging is a wholesale packaging supplier based in Moorabbin, Australia, operating offline. Founded in 2003, the company supplies a range of packaging products including brown paper bags, Christmas wrapping paper, boxes, tape, twine, ribbon, tissue paper, envelopes, and stationery. It serves the Australian market with a focus on wholesale packaging supplies for retail and gift wrapping needs.

Bulk Packaging is a distributor of flexible bulk packaging and liners, founded in 2002. The company employs between 51 and 200 people. It operates in the B2B packaging channel, focusing on flexible bulk packaging solutions.

Bunzl is a public company headquartered in London, UK, and operates as a specialist international distributor of foodservice and retail packaging, cleaning and hygiene products, safety consumables, and industrial packaging. It serves grocery, food processing, foodservice, and other business customers across North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, and Oceania. The company operates offline and represents brands such as Pactiv, Solo, Anchor Packaging, Huhtamaki, D&W Fine Pack, Dixie, Kimberly-Clark, Georgia-Pacific, Diversey, and Ecolab.

Burch Bottle & Packaging, founded in 1978 and headquartered in Queensbury, New York, is an online distributor of glass, plastic, and metal containers, caps and closures, corks, and supplies. They serve various industries including food and beverage, personal care, and cannabis, operating primarily in the United States. The company offers custom packaging solutions and warehouse options, with a focus on wholesale supply of packaging components.

BVS Verpacken is a privately held Swiss packaging solutions provider headquartered in Urdorf, Switzerland, operating offline. Founded in 1997, the company supplies a comprehensive range of packaging systems and consumables, including packing and shipping stations, film and bag packaging systems, protective and transport packaging, and related materials. It serves as a system partner for industry and logistics, offering consulting, service, and maintenance.

Carolina Retail Packaging is a privately held distributor of retail packaging and packaging supplies, headquartered in Lexington, South Carolina, United States. Founded in 1973, the company operates within the United States, focusing on serving the retail sector with packaging solutions. Its core categories include retail packaging and packaging supplies, with a specialty focus as a US retail packaging distributor. The company's channel mode is not specified in the provided facts.

Chase Packaging is a manufacturer and supplier of polythene and corrugated packaging, operating both online and offline in the United Kingdom. Founded in 1986 and headquartered in Enfield, UK, the company also supplies retail, food, tape, e-commerce, paper, and dry cleaner packaging products. They offer custom printing, bespoke packaging solutions, and consultancy on eco-friendly options.

Complete Packaging Products, founded in 2003 and headquartered in Troy, Michigan, is a distributor specializing in cargo securement and damage prevention products for rail, road, and ocean shipments. They supply dunnage bags, friction mats, cord strapping, honeycomb dunnage, stretch film, strapping products, edge protection, and packaging equipment. Operating offline across the United States, they represent brands such as Cyclone, LoadSecure, Tex-Steel, Ty-Gard 2000, and Cartier Packaging.

Container and Packaging Supply is an online wholesale supplier of plastic bottles, jars, closures, and other packaging containers, based in Eagle, Idaho, United States. Founded in 1971, the company serves product fillers and brand owners across the United States, offering a range of plastic, glass, recycled, and metal containers, as well as closures and additional services like custom printing and packaging design. The company operates primarily online, with a website that facilitates direct sales and customer engagement.

Cospak, founded in 1969 and headquartered in Minto, New South Wales, Australia, is a packaging distributor and manufacturer operating across Australia. As a subsidiary of San Miguel Yamamura Australasia, it supplies rigid packaging, glass and plastic containers, closures, and food and beverage packaging, with custom design and warehousing support. The company serves the wine, food, and beverage markets through both online and offline channels, representing multi-brand rigid packaging principals including SMYA.

Crawford Packaging is a privately held North American packaging distributor headquartered in London, Ontario, Canada, with operations across Canada, the United States, and Mexico. Founded in 1963, the company supplies stretch and shrink films, protective packaging, tape, packaging equipment, and automation solutions, offering both online and offline purchasing channels. It represents brands such as BVM, Gamma Plastic, Reisopack, Lantech, CKF, Wulftec, IPG, FROMM, Clysar, Little David, Global AGV, Cascades, Danmark, Ravenwood Packaging, and Balpex.

Crown Packaging, founded in 1969 and headquartered in Chesterfield, Missouri, is a distributor of packaging supplies and equipment in the United States. They offer a wide range of products including boxes, film, printing and labeling, bags, protective packaging, mailers, tapes, cold chain packaging, strapping, and edge protection. The company operates both online and offline, providing solutions for various industries such as consumer goods, industrial products, retail, e-commerce, logistics, medical, and food and beverage.

Davpack, founded in 1968 and headquartered in Derby, United Kingdom, is an online packaging supplier operating primarily in the UK. As a subsidiary of TAKKT AG, it offers a wide range of packaging products including cardboard boxes, postal packaging, protective packaging, polythene, retail packaging, and packaging consumables. The company provides same-day dispatch on over 5,000 in-stock items and emphasizes eco-friendly packaging options. Davpack operates through its online platform, serving businesses with fast delivery and a money-back guarantee.

Dayton Bag & Burlap, founded in 1910 and headquartered in Dayton, Ohio, is a distributor of burlap, sandbags, wire baskets, twine, and nursery supplies. They serve nursery/landscape and industrial/construction customers across the United States, offering Just In Time Delivery and 24-hour truckload delivery for emergency flood protection. The company operates both online and offline, with a large inventory of products including burlap rolls, sandbags, wire baskets, twine, and polypropylene products.

Delaware Valley Packaging, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Fairfield, California, is a subsidiary of Berlin Packaging. As a distribution and wholesale channel partner, it supplies flexible packaging materials including films, bags, pouches, stretch/shrink, and protective packaging. The company operates in the United States and offers both online and offline purchasing options.

Diversified Packaging Solutions is a full-line packaging distributor headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, operating in the United States. Founded in 1984, the company supplies packaging machinery and consumables including case erectors, sealers, stretch wrap, strapping, cushioning, inkjet labeling, and adhesives. They offer installation, maintenance, and repair services through factory-trained technicians and provide just-in-time delivery of over 15,000 stocked products. The company operates both online and offline, representing multi-brand packaging machinery and consumables principals.

Dollies and Boxes Unlimited is a Canadian distributor of moving supplies, boxes, and packaging materials, headquartered in Scarborough, Ontario. Founded in 1986, it operates across Canada and is a subsidiary of SupplyOne Canada (Crownhill family). The company specializes in moving and packaging supplies for the Canadian market.

Durable Packaging is a privately held packaging supplies distributor headquartered in Wheeling, Illinois, United States. Founded in 1944, the company operates across the United States, specializing in the distribution of packaging supplies. Its core category is packaging supplies, with a focus on serving the US market.

EcoPack is a privately owned sustainable packaging supplier based in Dandenong South, Victoria, Australia, operating since 1939. The company offers eco-friendly flexible packaging options, including compostable bin liners, mailing bags, dog poop bags, kitchen supplies, and tote bags, primarily for retailers. It serves the Australian market through both online and offline channels.

Emballage Direct is a French distributor and wholesale channel partner specializing in flexible packaging supplies, including films, bags, pouches, stretch/shrink wrap, and protective packaging. Headquartered in Toulouse, France, the company operates within France and was founded in 2022. Its website is currently under construction, indicating an online presence is planned or in development.

Emballages Carrousel is a privately held distributor of packaging supplies and foodservice packaging, headquartered in Quebec, Canada, and operating across Canada. Founded in 1971, the company specializes in flexible packaging materials and serves customers through both online and offline channels.

Empaques del Norte is a private Mexican distributor of packaging sacks and bags, headquartered in San Nicolas de los Garza, Nuevo Leon, with operational presence in Mexico. Founded in 1966, the company supplies woven polypropylene, laminated, printed, recycled, and used sacks, as well as supersacks, stretch film, and plastic film, primarily for the agricultural, mining, and industrial sectors. It operates offline, offering personalized service and efficient deliveries, with local delivery and shipments across Mexico for orders of 500 units or more.

Excel Pac is a privately held packaging distributor headquartered in San Diego, California, serving the United States. Founded in 1997, the company supplies a wide range of packaging products including corrugated boxes, stretch film, tape, cushioning, mailers, poly bags, can liners, cold chain packaging, and PPE. They operate offline, offering bulk pricing, custom packaging solutions, and weekly local deliveries.

Fastenal is a public industrial distributor headquartered in Winona, Minnesota, operating in the United States, Canada, Mexico, Puerto Rico, Panama, and China. The company supplies fasteners, industrial MRO, safety products, packaging and shipping supplies, and tools, primarily to manufacturing and construction customers. It operates both online and offline through branch and vending networks. Key brands are not publicly disclosed.

Fastpak Systems is a privately held value-added packaging distributor headquartered in Marietta, Georgia, serving the United States. Founded in 1986, the company supplies industrial packaging supplies and equipment, including stretch wrap, strapping, shrink film, and fulfillment products. Operating offline, Fastpak represents multiple packaging equipment and consumables brands.

Fillmore Container is a privately held distributor and supplier of packaging containers, specializing in glass bottles, jars, and closures. Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, the company operates across the United States. It offers a multi-brand range of containers and closures to meet diverse packaging needs.

Flexi-Films is a UK-based distributor of flexible packaging films, founded in 2019 and headquartered in Annesley, Nottingham. They supply a wide range of products including BOPP, BOPA/Nylon, PE films, PET, laminates, aluminium foil, and CPP films, serving sectors such as fresh produce, bakery, ready meals, medical, and carton window patching. Operating both online and offline across the UK, they offer services like stock holding, call-off programmes, account management, and technical support.

FlexPRO is a European packaging distributor headquartered in Sofia, Bulgaria, serving the Balkan region as the official sales office for BIRIZ AMBALAJ, a Turkish rotogravure printing house. The company supplies flexible packaging, pre-made pouches, and plastic containers, including options for food, pet food, and industrial applications. It operates both online and offline, with a focus on the Balkan market.

Freund Container & Supply is a Chicago-area distributor of plastic containers, closures, and packaging supplies for commercial and industrial packagers. Founded in 1938 and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, the company operates in the United States and serves customers through both online and offline channels.

Gerdmans is a Nordic B2B catalog supplier and subsidiary of TAKKT AG, operating online. Founded in 1947 and headquartered in Markaryd, Sweden, it serves Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland. The company supplies office furniture, warehouse storage, industrial furnishings, and packaging-related workplace equipment, supporting packing and storage environments.

Gertex Solutions is a distributor of packaging materials and equipment based in Etobicoke, Ontario, Canada, operating primarily in Canada. They supply a wide range of products including corrugated boxes, stretch wrap, shrink film, tape, void fill, mailers, custom labels, and warehouse supplies, as well as packaging automation equipment such as case sealers, erectors, palletizers, and stretch wrappers. Their services include custom branded tape, packaging product testing, stock and release workflow consulting, purchasing programs, and maintenance and repair. They operate both online and offline, representing brands such as Sealed Air, Robopac, Shanklin, Heat Seal, SMIpack, and Fox Packaging.

Global Industrial is a publicly traded online distributor of industrial and commercial supplies, headquartered in Port Washington, New York, with operations across the United States. Founded in 1949, the company offers a wide range of products including material handling, storage and shelving, packaging supplies, facility maintenance, and safety products. It serves businesses and public-sector customers through its e-commerce platform, providing hundreds of thousands of products and same-day shipping on most orders. The company operates primarily online, with customer support available via phone at 1-888-978-7759.

Global Packaging is a wholesale distributor of flexible packaging materials, headquartered in Vaughan, Ontario, Canada. The company operates across Canada and was founded in 2011. It employs between 201 and 500 people.

GM Packaging is an online distributor of food and beverage packaging based in Murton, County Durham, United Kingdom, operating across the UK and Europe. Founded in 2001, the company supplies a wide range of products including food packaging, takeaway containers, disposable cups, catering supplies, and sustainable packaging options. They focus on sustainable solutions and supply chain optimization, offering services such as bespoke packaging solutions.

Grainger is a public industrial supply distributor headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois, USA, operating across the United States. It supplies a broad range of industrial supplies, including packaging materials such as flexible films. Grainger serves customers through both online and offline channels.

Great Pacific Packaging is a distributor of packaging supplies based in Fife, Washington, operating primarily online. Founded in 1985, the company supplies a wide range of products including bags, boxes, mailers, tapes, and protective packaging, with a specialty in cannabis packaging such as glass jars, pre-roll tubes, and smell-proof bags. They serve customers across the United States.

GWP Group, founded in 1990 and headquartered in Cricklade, Wiltshire, United Kingdom, is a protective packaging manufacturer and distributor. It supplies corrugated, foam, Correx, anti-static, and related specialist packaging solutions, operating as a subsidiary of Macfarlane Group plc. The company serves the United Kingdom through both online and offline channels, representing brands such as Macfarlane and GWP.

HD Supply is a distributor of facilities maintenance, construction supplies, packaging, and MRO consumables, operating as a subsidiary of The Home Depot. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, it serves professional customers across the United States through both online and offline channels. Founded in 2007, the company offers a wide range of products and services, including custom products and business solutions.

Hillas Packaging is a distributor founded in 1981 and headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, United States. They supply a complete line of packaging machinery and related supplies, including abrasives, adhesives, bags, boxes, cushioning, films, strapping, tapes, and more. They operate online, offering an easy-to-use website with fast shipping and expert support. Key brands represented include 3M and Intertape.

Hisco, founded in 1970 and headquartered in Houston, Texas, is a specialty industrial distributor and a subsidiary of Distribution Solutions Group (NASDAQ: DSGR). Operating across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, the company supplies specialty chemicals, adhesives and tapes, electronic assembly materials, ESD and thermal materials, and packaging consumables. Hisco offers value-added services such as converting, VMI, and specialty warehousing including cold storage, and serves customers through both online and offline channels. It represents multiple brands in adhesives, tapes, and specialty materials.

Hoffmann Verpackung is a family-owned packaging merchant and producer headquartered in Kaarst, Germany, with additional locations in Germany and Switzerland. Since 1920, the company has supplied protective packaging, cartons, filling materials, films, tapes, and custom packaging design, serving industrial and trade customers. They operate both online and offline, offering design and sample support for shipping and protective packaging solutions.

Huckster Packaging & Supply is a privately held distributor of shipping and packaging supplies, headquartered in Houston, Texas, and operating across the United States. Founded in 1963, the company supplies poly bags, reclosable bags, and other shipping and packaging materials, with a specialty focus as a Houston-based distributor certified as HUB/MWBE. It operates both online and offline, offering an online store and a downloadable product catalog, and provides same-day shipping for orders placed before 1:00 pm CST.

Hughes Enterprises, founded in 1950 and headquartered in Levittown, Pennsylvania, is a distributor of packaging supplies and equipment, operating as a subsidiary of BradyPLUS/Imperial Brady. The company supplies industrial packaging supplies, packaging equipment, stretch/shrink, strapping, void fill, and tapes, and operates both online and offline in the United States.

Igepa Group is a private European specialist wholesale group headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, founded in 1960. It distributes graphic papers, packaging materials, visual communication media, and print accessories to printers, packagers, and visual communication businesses. The company operates across multiple European countries including Germany, Austria, Belgium, and others, with both online and offline sales channels.

Imperial Bag & Paper, part of the Imperial Dade group, is a private distributor of foodservice packaging, commercial cleaning supplies, janitorial equipment, industrial packaging, office supplies, and personal protection & safety products. Founded in 1935 and headquartered in Jersey City, NJ, it operates across the United States with both online and offline channels. The company represents brands such as 3M, Dart, P&G Professional, Essity, GP Pro, Rubbermaid, GOJO, Hoffmaster, Spartan Chemical, Clorox, and Tennant.

Imperial Dade, founded in 1935 and headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey, is a private North American distributor of foodservice packaging, janitorial and sanitation products, industrial packaging, and facility supplies. Operating across the United States and Canada, the company serves foodservice, healthcare, education, and commercial facility customers through both online and offline channels. Key brands represented include Dart, Solo, Georgia-Pacific, Dixie, and GP PRO.

Imperial Supplies is a distributor of fleet maintenance and shop supplies, offering over 1.5 million products including heavy-duty truck parts, safety items, and facility supplies. They provide services such as dedicated account advisors, auto-reorder, inventory optimization, and spend analytics to help customers manage purchasing and focus on their operations. The company operates online and is headquartered in Green Bay, Wisconsin, United States, with a presence across the United States.

Inapa is a public paper and packaging merchant group headquartered in Sintra, Portugal, operating across Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, Spain, Belgium, Luxembourg, Turkey) and Angola. It distributes graphic papers, packaging products, visual communication materials, and office supplies, with related logistics services. The company serves clients through both online and offline channels, leveraging over 60 years of experience and partnerships with more than 150 leading brands.

India Pack is a packaging procurement partner based in Pune, Maharashtra, India, operating offline. Founded in 2016, the company specializes in industrial and flexible packaging, particularly FIBCs and PP woven bags, and also supplies BOPP laminated bags, leno bags, flexible pouches, corrugated boxes, and PP woven fabric. It serves industries such as mining, construction, agriculture, food, chemicals, and hazardous goods, sourcing from a vetted network of audited Indian manufacturers.

Individual FoodService is a distributor of foodservice packaging, paper, plastic, janitorial supplies, and industrial packaging. Founded in 1926 and headquartered in Bell, California, it operates in the United States as a subsidiary of BradyPLUS/Imperial Brady. The company sells online and can be contacted at (323) 981-2800 or ecomsupport@indfood.com.

Industrial & Shippers Supply is a privately held packaging distributor headquartered in Houston, Texas, operating across the United States. Founded in 1954, the company supplies packaging equipment, shipping supplies, labeling, stretch/shrink materials, and industrial packaging. It represents multiple brands of packaging equipment and consumables, serving as a multi-brand distributor with both online and offline presence.

Industrial Packaging is a private company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Southport, Merseyside, United Kingdom, operating within the UK. It serves as a supplier of industrial packaging supplies, offering a range of flexible packaging products for retail and industrial applications.
